englishSummary.headline: Teams purge guidance is presented more clearly
englishSummary.summary: The page clarifies that cmdlet purges affect only mailbox compliance copies, while Graph purges targeting `teamsMessages` permanently delete Teams messages regardless of `purgeType`. Separate requests are required to purge both copies.
englishSummary.adminImpact: Use the documented purge-area distinctions to avoid leaving user-visible messages in Teams or permanently deleting messages unintentionally.
